import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(str_input):
        count = 1
        while i + count < len(str_input) and str_input[i + count] == str_input[i]:
            count += 1
        if count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i += count
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
